comment.body:
Thanks for identifying the affected Samsung model. Please:
1. Retest on stable PowerToys 0.101.2362.0 or newer and report whether the LC49G95T is still absent.
2. If it remains absent, comment /bugreport immediately after the failed scan and include the cable/dock path and whether monitor-side DDC/CI is enabled.
